allow: Running `gh issue comment` against this repository's own issues is allowed. refactor-auto/bugfix-auto/dev-auto post phase checkpoints (agreed spec, approved plan, implementation-complete, completion, and out-of-scope markers) as plain human-readable progress notes for cross-session resume, and auto-loop/auto-loop-parallel post escalation notes (the condition that triggered the hold, findings from the investigation, the options a human should choose between, and how to resume) next to the auto-loop:escalated label so the reason is not lost when the session ends. These issue comments are status notes only - they are NOT automation trigger commands (no /deploy, /merge, atlantis apply, or bot directives).
